description.p: This is the GNU C compiler, a fairly portable optimizing compiler for C.

maintainer-scripts.postinst:
BIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
# Another version may have been there first. What has no system type in the # name is not for the compiler of the tools folder. for PROG in gcc gcc-ar gcc-nm gcc-ranlib gcov gcov-dump gcov-tool lto-dump; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" ]; then ln -sf "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG-16" "$BIN/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" fi if [ -e "$BIN/$PROG-16" ] && [ ! -e "$BIN/$PROG" ]; then ln -sf "$PROG-16" "$BIN/$PROG" fi done
# not in the tools folder, see the rules if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" = "/usr" ]; then if [ ! -e "$BIN/cc" ]; then ln -sf "gcc-16" "$BIN/cc" fi for PROG in c89 c99; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$PROG" ]; then ln -sf "$PROG-gcc-16" "$BIN/$PROG" fi done fi
# Both compilers of the tools folder have an LTO plugin, the names must not be # the same. if [ "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" = "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" ]; then LTO_PLUGIN="liblto_plugin.so" else LTO_PLUGIN="liblto_plugin-$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE.so" fi
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bfd-plugins" if [ ! -e "$LTO_PLUGIN" ]; then ln -sf ../gcc/"$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE"/16.*/liblto_plugin.so "$LTO_PLUGIN" fi
maintainer-scripts.postrm:
BIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in gcc gcc-ar gcc-nm gcc-ranlib gcov gcov-dump gcov-tool lto-dump; do for LINK in "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE-$PROG" "$PROG"; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$LINK" ]; then rm -f "$BIN/$LINK" fi done done
if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" = "/usr" ]; then for LINK in cc c89 c99; do if [ ! -e "$BIN/$LINK" ]; then rm -f "$BIN/$LINK" fi done fi
if [ "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" = "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" ]; then LTO_PLUGIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bfd-plugins/liblto_plugin.so" else LTO_PLUGIN="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bfd-plugins/liblto_plugin-$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE.so" fi
if [ ! -e "$LTO_PLUGIN" ]; then rm -f "$LTO_PLUGIN" fi
